<script>
    $.ajax({
    url: "/web/json/directory/user/current", // API endpoint for current user
    method: "GET",
    success: function(response) {
        console.log("Current User Details:", response);

        // Extract department ID if available
        var departmentId = response.departmentId || "No department assigned";
        console.log("Department ID:", departmentId);

        // If you need the department name and have a custom mapping:
        getDepartmentName(departmentId);
    },
    error: function(err) {
        console.error("Error fetching current user details:", err);
    }
});

// Example function to map or fetch department names (if API or mapping exists)
function getDepartmentName(departmentId) {
    var departmentMapping = {
        "dept1": "HR Department",
        "dept2": "IT Department",
        "dept3": "Finance"
    };

    var departmentName = departmentMapping[departmentId] || "Unknown Department";
    console.log("Department Name:", departmentName);
}

</script>
